verdict.rationale: Jira's feature pages claim you can break big projects and ideas into actionable tasks, including AI-assisted breakdown with Rovo, which covers the decomposition half of the story at a marketing level. Nothing in the pack shows issue linking, dependency or blocking relationships, or any view that makes blocking order clear. missing for 10: evidence of dependency/blocking issue links, explicit subtask issue-type documentation, visualization of blocking order, independent or hands-on corroboration.
